args.summary: Following the deploy of v2.3.1, checkout-api began failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate of 18%. Per the platform runbook, the service was rolled back in all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release confirmed healthy in production. Post-rollback verification confirms the service is healthy on v2.3.0 across all regions with error rate reduced to 0.2%. The v2.3.1 release requires investigation before any redeploy.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was failing health checks in all production regions with an 18% error rate. The most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Verified the service is now healthy with error rate down to 0.2%.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident** `INC-0001` (on-call paged) documenting the failure, the rollback to v2.3.0, and post-rollback verification. Note that v2.3.1 should be investigated before any redeploy attempt.
